pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 The trigger system enqueues jobs for a fixed registry of compiled scraping apps when a source event fires; it is not a delivery system that runs a repository's build definition with credentials. Searching crates/server for GITHUB_TOKEN, workflow_dispatch, pull_request, CI_JOB_TOKEN and runs-on found no hits, so this subject's precondition (an orchestrator executing pipeline instructions on runners) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 A trigger's target is an app id that is already registered, not commands authored in a repository, so there is no CI decide/perform boundary to draw.
crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 No external orchestrator instructs runners. Triggers are evaluated in-process.
crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 No outside contributor changes a build definition that this code executes.
crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 No job runs a proposed change's code.
crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 No pipeline result gates a merge.
crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 No gate here reads CI run artefacts.
